scope: C4-A precondition audit after C4-P0/P1 and the narrow C4-P2 precursor; it does not implement C4-A capture or replay.
rules: A C4-A event requires one named same-instance owner carrier and its actual ready-valid fire.

Every required schema field must be present on that carrier; a testbench constant, private owner state, descriptor image, later reclaim_complete, or outer functional-memory observation is not a substitute.
A zero-buffer observer may backpressure only the selected carrier and must preserve atomic event/carrier fire.
C4-P2 remains a narrow precursor, not C4-A closure.

candidates.name: attention_terminal
candidates.field_provenance: all fields are present on the terminal bundle

candidates.name: descriptor_invalidate
candidates.field_provenance: allocator_release_out carries only old page_ref/generation; the existing RTL2.5.5 adapter supplies descriptor_operation=Invalidate and delivery_context_ref=R5Reclaim as constants.
candidates.fail_closed_reason: The required operation and delivery-context fields are not fields of one accepted C3b owner carrier. C4-A must not convert the historical adapter constants into inferred owner-produced event fields.

candidates.name: page_free
candidates.field_provenance: both fields are the exact old PageRef on allocator_release_out after the matching durable invalidation terminal
candidates.required_c4_a_change: Insert the existing test-only reclaim adapter at the R5 allocator_release_out boundary, exposing only page_free and preserving same-fire backpressure.

candidates.name: retire_ack
candidates.field_provenance: all fields are present on the outward R6 acknowledgement bundle

r5_old_page_ref_release.classification: exact owner-produced post-durable observation; it can authorize page_free only, not descriptor_invalidate's missing fields.
